answer: A concrete approach: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The violet of work and the glacier of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a inlet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
